Earlier known as Willingdon Bridge, later renamed as Vivekananda Setu.

Built in December 1932, it is a multispan steel bridge and was built to provide road cum rail link between the Calcutta Port and its hinterland

It links Bally (Howrah) to Dakshineswar (Kolkata).
